findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed there was not a sanitizer bucket available. Corrected - The PIC borrowed a neighboring trucks sanitizer and created a bucket testing at 200 ppm (quat).
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed there was not a triple sink available (serving drinks with ice and cutting fruit). Corrected - Using the neighboring trucks triple sink for today and inspector will spot check tomorrow.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.
